demo.reason: Playback controls, changing track state, artist-reactive palettes, recent tracks, and idle behavior are faster to understand in motion.

features.title: Your music stays glanceable.
features.subtitle: The track is the focus; the controls are always right there.
items: Large auto-fitting title and artist use the display instead of shrinking into a card.
Previous, play or pause, and next stay available as large touch targets.
Four artist-reactive palette styles keep the panel visually alive without fake album art.
When music stops, the panel becomes a clean clock instead of a dead rectangle.
